newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may cut Pioneer credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may cut Pioneer credit ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday that it had placed Pioneer Electronic Corp's long-term and short-term credit ratings under review for possible downgrades.

The rating agency said it was reviewing the Baa2 long-term debt rating of Pioneer and the Prime-2 short-term debt ratings of Pioneer Financial Management Inc and Pioneer Electronic BV, both of which are guaranteed by Pioneer. Pioneer"s poor operating performance and cash flow may continue over the intermediate term because of continuing price pressures, the company"s concentration on the maturing audio visual product market, and its weakening market position in some product markets.
